title: Change-record batch receipt
description: seal_batch(request, audit) validates the entire request before the first audit call, without modifying it. Invalid request or non-callable audit raises ValueError; error text is unspecified. Serialize each event independently using JSON keys sorted lexicographically, separators comma and colon without spaces, ensure_ascii=True, then ASCII bytes. Retain event list order. Starting from 32 zero bytes, replace digest with SHA-256(previous digest bytes + event bytes); call audit(zero-based event index, lowercase hexadecimal digest) once after each step. Return batch_id, event_count, components and final_digest. components contains objects with component and event_count, in component first-appearance order. A batch ID is returned as metadata; it is not part of event encoding or the digest. Empty events yield empty components, no audit calls and 64 zero hex characters. If audit raises, propagate the same exception immediately; do not continue, return a receipt, suppress the error, or roll back already performed audit effects. Event/checkpoint order, all intermediate digests and summary fields are observable requirements. The CLI uses an in-memory audit collector and emits an object with receipt and checkpoints (each has index and digest); it does not write an external ledger. Invalid CLI input yields no successful JSON and a nonzero exit.
